candidates.statement: Inventory 3.3.9 deployed with an invalid configuration (cfg-1103, configuration_valid=false), causing configuration_value_rejected errors (6 log occurrences, 7 metric rejections) and 503s; gateway calls to inventory error at ~2003ms and inventory checkout spans error, driving the checkout error-rate/latency alert.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone cannot establish causation; gateway metrics/logs show low error rate and 200s, so alert scope vs. inventory-local errors is not fully reconciled.

report.explanation: Inventory shows an invalid configuration revision (cfg-1103) on version 3.3.9 with configuration_value_rejected errors and 503s, plus erroring checkout spans; gateway traces show erroring calls to inventory. This supports bad-configuration as the bounded root-cause candidate. Gateway metrics/logs appear healthy, so full alert alignment is uncertain.
